sources.title: Unit repository boundaries
sources.publicSafeAbstraction: The IAM product layer owns identity, personas, workers, orchestration, permissions, memory, retrieval, prompts, goals, proof records, dashboards, and product policy. The general execution kernel remains separate and receives only typed graphs and explicit capability grants.

sources.title: Unit public overview
sources.publicSafeAbstraction: Programs can be understood as graphs composed from multi-input, multi-output units. The visual environment emphasizes direct manipulation, experimentation, composition, sandboxing, and approachable software sharing.
unsafeExclusions: third-party contact details not needed by VisionaryBrains
implementation examples irrelevant to IAM teaching

sources.title: PBOS artifact-vault governance summary
unsafeExclusions: private repository location
canonical storage procedures
promotion controls
license and provenance operations
teachingPotential: internal evidence discipline may later yield a public-derived stewardship principle

sources.title: Unit kernel contract
sources.publicSafeAbstraction: Stable graph identity is separated from mutable runtime state. Snapshots preserve restorable state and sequence; ordered events preserve the path of transformation; external effects must be explicit and recorded when replayability or proof matters.
unsafeExclusions: claims that snapshots reproduce consciousness, persons, or souls
determinism claims when external effects were not recorded
moral, spiritual, or legal identity claims based on hashes
production-authority claims derived from a candidate contract
covenant doctrine unsupported by the source
teachingPotential: identity as stable form plus changing state
bounded recursion as return with restorable context

sources.title: IAM Constitutional Genome — public-safe constitutional abstraction
sources.reference: File Library artifact: IAM_Constitutional_Genome_Framework.docx, version 1.0, dated 2026-07-17
sources.sourceStatus: controlled working draft; internal source transformed into a non-authoritative public abstraction
sources.publicSafeAbstraction: IAM can be taught as an organized-cognition architecture whose commitments must be bounded, interpretable, testable, traceable, versioned, and open to amendment. Ethical action preserves legitimate agency, remains proportionate and contestable, records lineage, and treats correction and repair as part of accountability. Adaptation may refine expression but must not silently replace identity, purpose, authority, or constitutional limits.
unsafeExclusions: the complete internal gene, chromosome, stratum, scorecard, and release-gate specifications
claims of biological equivalence, sentience, autonomous personhood, or inherited moral authority
internal schemas, operational controls, private source lineage, and implementation details
medical, legal, psychological, spiritual, or governmental authority claims
using the term covenant as established doctrine when the source does not define it
teachingPotential: ethical action as agency plus proportionality plus contestability
repair as a necessary part of accountability
lineage as traceable continuity and compatibility

sources.title: Césairean Theory in IAM — public-safe symbolic interpretation abstraction
sources.sourceStatus: internal academic working monograph transformed into a non-authoritative public abstraction
sources.publicSafeAbstraction: IAM's symbolic vocabulary can be taught as an optional, editable language for noticing context, relationships, uncertainty, transition, memory, and accumulated pressure. Fields describe bounded relational situations; rings describe bounded traversal; gravity wells describe accumulated salience or inertia and become computational only when tied to explicit measurable proxies. Semantic sovereignty requires interpretations applied to people to remain inspectable, contestable, transformable, and recomposable.
unsafeExclusions: internal module inventories, schemas, dependency registers, authority receipts, release controls, and implementation plans
private archive references, conversation lineage, project identifiers, and operational mechanics
claims that symbolic language reveals objective hidden truth, diagnoses people, predicts destiny, or overrides consent
literal physical-status claims for fields, rings, gravity wells, dimensions, echoes, or dreams
compulsory belief, privileged interpreters, manipulative spiritual framing, or aesthetic coherence treated as evidence
memory retention or symbolic reuse that conflicts with privacy, deletion, or consent
covenant doctrine unsupported by the source
teachingPotential: metaphor as lens rather than verdict

sources.title: IAM Pilot Specification — public-safe agency and interface abstraction
sources.reference: File Library artifact: IAM_Pilot_Specification_v0.1.docx, draft version 0.1, dated 2026-07-17
sources.sourceStatus: internal architectural draft transformed into a non-authoritative public abstraction
sources.publicSafeAbstraction: IAM can be taught as a situated interface that helps people frame possibilities, translate among representations, witness consequences, and return understandable results without collapsing possibility, resolution, evidence, and authorization into one category. Agency includes authorship over the framing of choices while explicit constraints, permissions, evidence requirements, and recovery paths remain visible. Operational conscience is the disciplined practice of checking clarity, authority, provenance, proportionality, reversibility, and future viability before presenting or acting on a transformation.
unsafeExclusions: internal component names, topology, message schemas, identifiers, receipts, hashes, thresholds, budgets, and implementation contracts
claims that an interface independently authorizes consequential action or becomes the source of domain truth
claims that operational conscience proves consciousness, personhood, moral infallibility, spiritual authority, or autonomous legal status
private workflow mechanics, source conversation lineage, operational modes, and unpublished governance controls
poetic or mythic display language treated as machine identity, evidence, or self-authenticating truth
covenant doctrine unsupported by the source
teachingPotential: possibility is not resolution and resolution is not authorization
agency as authorship under explicit constraint
operational conscience as checks before action
uncertainty and lossy translation made visible
recovery and escape paths as interface stewardship
